composition_label: Adaptive onboarding -> Ticket triage & routing -> Interest-based recommendations

construction.implementation_origin: New reference implementation authored directly in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.envelope: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, status=ok, stage, request; stages successively add onboarding, triage, recommendations
shared_schema.request: profile, tickets, routing, catalog, limit; all fields required and unknown fields rejected
shared_schema.profile: experience: beginner|intermediate|expert; presentation: guided|concise; interests: tag -> integer 1..5; excluded_tags: unique text list; completed_steps: prerequisite-closed step ID list
shared_schema.tickets: Unique id, nonblank text, status open|resolved
shared_schema.routing: default_category, default_owner, default_priority, onboarding_owner, ordered rules
shared_schema.rule: Unique id, nonempty unique keywords, category, priority low|normal|high|urgent, owner, prerequisites, avoid_tags
shared_schema.catalog: Unique id, title, nonempty unique tags
shared_schema.limit: Integer 0..100; booleans not accepted as integers
shared_schema.validation: validate_state is the common boundary; request schema plus deterministic semantic equality validates every existing stage; malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys and non-finite constants rejected
shared_schema.errors: CLI prints one JSON object with status error and exits 2 on validation, decoding, usage or file errors

cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Verified completion, never planned completion, determines missing routing prerequisites and accountable onboarding owner
Preferences drive scores; union of user exclusions and all matched open-ticket rule restrictions filters catalog items, retaining ticket provenance

behavior.onboarding: Beginner targets basics, privacy, workspace; intermediate/expert also target automation. Completed prerequisite-closed steps are skipped. Presentation selects concise or guided explanations. Available-now differs from merely ordered prerequisites.
behavior.triage: Case-insensitive literal substring matching. Highest priority wins; configuration order breaks ties. Missing prerequisites on open tickets assign onboarding_owner, preserving category_owner. Resolved tickets neither reroute to onboarding nor suppress recommendations.
behavior.recommendations: Tags are exact case-sensitive identifiers. Sum matching user weights, enforce exclusions before ranking, omit zero-match items, sort descending score then ascending ID, apply limit. Explanations expose exact score contributions and excluded-tag/ticket provenance.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clock-based behavior, live providers, mutable input updates or external state

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: one JSON object, status ok, final stage interests, exit 0
coverage: CLI success, usage, file and malformed JSON errors
